items.q: What types of coworking plans do you offer?
items.a: Inspire Workplace offers hot desks, dedicated desks, private cabins, managed offices, virtual office plans and training room bookings.

items.q: Can I book a tour before signing up?
items.a: Yes. You can book a free tour to see the workspace, rooftop cafeteria, cabins and available seating before choosing a plan.

items.q: Do you provide a GST registration address?
items.a: Yes. The virtual office plan includes an ORR business address for GST registration, mail handling and meeting room hours.

items.q: Is Inspire Workplace suitable for teams?
items.a: Yes. Private cabins support 4 to 10 seats, while managed office plans can be customised for larger teams of around 15 to 50 seats.
